title: Calibrated direct-greedy ES minimal signal retry
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: Outcome-blind calibrated sigma 0.8 will activate a reproducible mirrored direct-greedy fitness signal on a wholly new seed: at least one nonzero antithetic difference, positive split-half direction correlation, a nonzero bounded center update, and positive gen0-to-gen1 untouched broad-holdout slope without material Standard10 drift.
material_change: Repeat only one generation of the state-conditioned ES mechanism on new seed 20262010 using sigma 0.8 selected without rewards. Keep eight directions, six training opponents, both seats, 32 common-deck pairs per opponent, robust fitness, three untouched holdouts, output-only learned weights, residual cap 0.25, and center step L2 0.05. Stop after the minimal 6,144-hand signal gate.
baseline: Sigma 0.005 produced zero changes over 12,288 hands. Outcome-blind calibration selected sigma 0.8 with 0.83%-1.88% direction-wise greedy disagreement and cap-safe residual logits. No strength evidence exists yet for activated ES.

result.summary: Calibrated sigma 0.8 activated all eight mirrored direct-greedy fitness differences on a wholly new 6,144-hand cohort and produced a nonzero L2=0.05 learned center update. However, independent half-deck direction rankings correlated -0.6313. Untouched broad validation moved -21.3542 bb/100 with CI half-width 41.8542, driven by one holdout and seat1; source agreement remained 99.8535%. All 264 tests passed.
result.conclusion: The perturbation mechanism is now active, but 32 pairs per opponent do not provide a reproducible ES direction: the strongest preregistered signal check is sharply negative and the noisy untouched validation points the same way. This rejects taking a second optimization generation at the current direction-sampling budget. It does not yet reject direct-greedy ES as undertrained, because the causal failure is estimator variance and the validation interval is broad.
result.next_step: Run one fixed-center, no-update direction-SNR scale control at four times the common-deck pairs per opponent. Compare direction rankings across disjoint halves/quarters and against the saved 32-pair cohort. Continue ES only if correlation becomes positive and direction signs stabilize; otherwise close the route as sample-inefficient on current hardware.
